shortDefinition.en: Camera-controlled lens focusing for a selected subject or focus area.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 由相机控制镜头，针对所选主体或对焦区域进行对焦。

en: A focus confirmation does not prevent motion blur or guarantee that the intended subject was selected.
zh-cn: 对焦确认不能防止运动模糊，也不保证相机选中了你想拍的主体。

example.en: AF-S can be a starting point for a building, while AF-C can help with a person changing distance.
example.zh-cn: 拍摄建筑可从 AF-S 开始，人物距离不断变化时可尝试 AF-C。

sources.title: Autofocus — FUJIFILM X-T5 Owner’s Manual
sources.supports: Autofocus operation, focus modes, focus areas, and their limitations.
